about: Verification report for buildings.geojson (not a contract file). Derived from OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0) and City of Melbourne Open Data (2023 Building Footprints, 3D Point Cloud 2018, Municipal boundary; CC BY 4.0).

pointcloud.rule: |cloud - CoM| <= 3 m: CoM height confirmed (com_pointcloud_2018). Larger: the cloud replaces CoM only if the CoM capture predates the cloud (May 2018); otherwise CoM is kept (com_open_data).
